stories.title: JioStar recruits cricket stars for World Cup campaign
stories.summary: JioStar has launched a campaign featuring Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli ahead of the ODI series against Sri Lanka. The film, which includes captain Shubman Gill, builds anticipation for the 2027 ICC Men's Cricket World Cup. The tournament is currently less than a year away.

stories.title: Livon targets hair management with new campaign
stories.summary: Marico has launched a campaign for Livon, promoting the brand as an essential for gorgeous, manageable hair anytime and anywhere. The brand positions itself as a solution for young women to navigate unexpected hair moments. Looking your best is now a matter of two minutes.

stories.title: Canara HSBC Life Insurance pairs Bumrah with Ganesan
stories.summary: Canara HSBC Life Insurance has launched a campaign featuring brand ambassadors Jasprit Bumrah and Sanjana Ganesan. The marketing focuses on the brand's Promises Ka Partner commitment, linking disciplined planning to meaningful outcomes. The campaign highlights the precision required for both cricket and financial security.

stories.title: Saif Ali Khan becomes face of Gowardhan Ghee
stories.summary: Parag Milk Foods has appointed Saif Ali Khan as the brand ambassador for its Gowardhan ghee line. The partnership follows a television quiz show appearance where the actor was gifted a two-year supply of the product. The brand will now feature him in integrated marketing campaigns.

stories.title: Nestasia turns to cactus birthday parties for marketing
stories.summary: Nestasia has launched a year-end campaign titled You Will Do Anything To Bring It Out. The film features a couple hosting an elaborate birthday party for a cactus to demonstrate that special occasions are not required to use fine serveware. The cactus did not provide a comment.

stories.title: Hilary Rhoda signs Adah Sharma for festive campaign
stories.summary: Beauty brand Hilary Rhoda has named actor Adah Sharma as the face of its Iss Festive Thoda Aurr campaign. The brand aims to strengthen its national presence by leveraging Sharma's approachable personality and individuality. The partnership focuses on engaging consumers through culturally relevant storytelling.

stories.title: McDonald’s revives Home Alone for holiday meal
stories.summary: McDonald’s has released a holiday film featuring Macaulay Culkin in an empty restaurant. The commercial promotes the Home Alone Meal by showing the actor operating an unattended McFlurry machine. The film ends with the observation that an empty house is a kingdom, or at least a restaurant.

stories.title: ENVY adds Janhvi Kapoor to fragrance portfolio
stories.summary: Fragrance brand ENVY has appointed Janhvi Kapoor as brand ambassador to help expand its Eau de Parfum segment. The partnership includes a campaign titled Nice Perfume, which features Kapoor and Varun Dhawan. The brand intends to use the association to appeal to younger consumers.

stories.title: Luminous updates brand identity with Sachin Tendulkar
stories.summary: Luminous has launched its Solar Wali Soch campaign featuring Sachin Tendulkar to promote its solar ecosystem. The company introduced a new tagline, Har Soch Mein Power, to emphasize energy solutions for modern households. The campaign focuses on consumer demand for uninterrupted power and electricity bill savings.

stories.title: Madhuri Dixit returns to BoroPlus for winter campaign
stories.summary: Emami has named Madhuri Dixit as the brand ambassador for BoroPlus Ayurvedic Antiseptic Cream. The winter campaign, produced by RH Films, centers on the theme of family care through small gestures. The brand positions the cream as a multi-purpose expression of warmth and protection.

stories.title: Publicis Media's Spark Foundry wins OPPO India's Rs 150-crore media mandate - IMPACT Magazine
Campaign Lab secures Norwegian Cruise PR account
stories.summary: Independent agency Campaign Lab has won the public relations account for Norwegian Cruise Line in Australia and New Zealand. The agency will manage media relations and creative campaigns as the cruise operator rolls out its new global brand platform. The pitch was competitive.

stories.title: Special PR wins Nutella PR, social and influencer account - Mi-3.com.au.
Edelman promotes Ngo Thi Lan Phuong in Vietnam
stories.summary: Edelman has appointed Ngo Thi Lan Phuong as general manager of its Vietnam operations. Known as LP, she previously served as senior vice president of brand and operations. She will now lead the firm's efforts to integrate reputation and marketing services for multinational and local clients.

stories.title: Agency reports lower costs for healthcare ad campaigns
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based Studio Happens claims to have reduced Cost-Per-Acquisition by 38 percent for healthcare clients by using targeted keywords. The agency suggests that broad search queries lead to ad wastage for dental and medical providers. Focused infrastructure is presented as the primary driver of these results.

stories.title: WPP Media hires Jobin Jose for client service
stories.summary: Jobin Jose has joined WPP Media as vice president of client service in India. He previously spent eight years at Interactive Avenues, where he led integrated media strategy. In his new role, he will manage the digital media business for JSW Motors.

stories.title: Publicis Media adds Rohin Desai as senior vice president
stories.summary: Rohin Desai has joined Publicis Media as senior vice president. He previously served as chief client officer for media buying at Madison World. His career includes leadership roles at Mindshare India and Enterr10 Television, focusing on media buying, trading, and revenue strategy.

stories.title: ScanX platform targets Indian retail investors
stories.summary: ScanX is a new stock screener and market research platform designed for the Indian market. The company claims it aims to help users analyze markets and participate in the country's economic growth. The platform targets a growing demographic of financially literate Indians who value high-quality services.

stories.title: Creativeland Asia wins global creative mandate for D’YAVOL Spirits
stories.summary: Creativeland Asia has secured the global creative mandate for D’YAVOL Spirits following a multi-agency pitch. The agency aims to build cultural relevance for the brand, which is co-founded by Shah Rukh Khan and Aryan Khan. The partnership covers communications in India and international markets.

stories.title: Instagram launches Content Protection to detect video copies and help creators claim credit - Buzzincontent
Government partners with Meta to launch microdrama series on online scams
stories.summary: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, SEBI, and other agencies have partnered with Meta to launch a microdrama series on Instagram. The initiative aims to educate users on online frauds like fake job offers and digital arrests. The series will also be available on Waves OTT.

stories.title: Husband drafts gaming contract for influencer wife ahead of GTA 6 launch
stories.summary: A Singaporean influencer shared a signed agreement with her husband outlining conditions for his gaming time during the launch of GTA 6. The post has received over 42,300 likes on Instagram. The game series has been a best-seller since its 1997 debut.

stories.title: Mythpat among four Indian creators chosen for YouTube’s GTA VI global celebration
stories.summary: Mythpat will represent India during YouTube’s 24-hour livestream celebrating the launch of GTA VI. The event is organized in partnership with Rockstar Games. His selection is described as a testament to the growing international recognition of Indian gaming creators.

stories.title: Unilever expands creator network to 5 lakh, reports 1.5x returns
stories.summary: Unilever has grown its global creator network from 75,000 in 2024 to over 500,000 in 2026. Chief Marketing Officer Leandro Barreto stated that creator content delivers 1.5 times the return of traditional brand content. The company is shifting toward a social-first demand generation model.

stories.title: Unilever scales creator network to 5 lakh, says influencer content delivers 1.5x returns
stories.summary: Unilever has expanded its global creator network to over 500,000 members. At its 2026 investor meet, the company reported that influencer-led content yields 1.5 times the return of traditional brand advertising. The strategy integrates AI-powered content production and smarter media buying.

stories.title: TikTok videos and creators are coming to Disney+ in December 2026
stories.summary: Disney+ will begin hosting TikTok videos in December 2026, coinciding with the release of Marvel's Avengers: Doomsday. The integration follows a partnership announced in August that allows creators to use material from Disney movies and series in short-form content.

stories.title: Meesho taps into YouTube shopping to onboard 2 lakh creators
stories.summary: Meesho has partnered with YouTube Shopping to allow creators to tag products directly in videos and livestreams. The integration provides access to over 30 million affiliate products across 40 categories. The company plans to onboard more than 2 lakh creators through the initiative.

stories.title: Influencer Sharan Hegde faces backlash over 'financial trap' remark
stories.summary: Financial influencer Sharan Hegde sparked social media debate by labeling parenthood a financial trap. He cited rising living costs, housing prices, and education fees as primary concerns for young Indians. The post has drawn criticism regarding his assessment of financial pressures.

stories.title: YouTube and Meesho open new pathways - News Today | First with the news - News Today
Advertisers suspend TikTok activity in response to Spanish CSAM investigation
stories.summary: Several advertisers in Spain, including Santander and Moeve, have paused spending on TikTok following reports of child sexual abuse material on the platform. The move follows an investigation by Maldita.es. Agencies are currently reviewing their presence on the app.

stories.title: Media Briefing: ChatGPT’s new business hub is an early ‘search console moment’ for publishers
stories.summary: OpenAI has launched a business hub providing publishers with AI visibility and click data. The tool aims to help media companies track how their content appears in AI interactions. Analysts are comparing the functionality to early search engine analytics tools.

stories.title: Meta brings its updated Creator Dashboard to the web
stories.summary: Meta has released an updated management console for creators on the web. The interface is designed to replace existing tools as the primary control panel for managing in-app creator presence.

stories.title: Snapchat enables Lens creation via third-party AI tools
stories.summary: Snapchat has introduced the Easy Lens command line interface. The tool allows users to build augmented reality Lenses using their preferred third-party AI chatbot.

stories.title: YouTube will pad TV view counts, but creators won't earn more - Gagadget.com
Meta introduces Instagram
stories.summary: Meta is testing Direct, a standalone messaging app from Instagram for one-to-one and group conversations, in Türkiye and Thailand. The app is available to users with or without an Instagram account. Those with an existing Instagram account can log in using their current credentials, with existing chats synchronised across both

stories.title: YouTube launches 'Co-Views' metric estimating viewers watching together on TV - NewsBytes
Meta launches messaging app for teens
stories.summary: Meta has released Direct, a new messaging application designed to move Instagram direct messages to a separate platform. The app is intended specifically for teen users.

stories.title: Meta uses AI agents to scale machine learning
stories.summary: Meta is using its Ranking Engineer Agent to design experiments and prove new machine learning techniques for ads ranking models. The company reports that AI agents now handle over 60 percent of all technique propagation across its fleet of models. The agents began driving execution in March 2026.

stories.title: Enterprise AI governance alone can’t protect your brand - MarTech
SalesCloser adds AI video agents to Shopify
stories.summary: SalesCloser has introduced an app for Shopify that places a lifelike AI avatar on merchant storefronts. The agent can speak with shoppers, help them find products, and assist with the checkout process. The company describes itself as a pioneer in autonomous AI sales technology.

stories.title: Martech features often remain on the roadmap
stories.summary: Marketing software vendors frequently demonstrate new capabilities that are not yet available for daily use. CMOs are cautioned to verify regional availability and data integrations before approving budgets for features that may still be in the product roadmap phase. Demonstrations are not always proof of readiness.

stories.title: accessiBe integrates agentic accessibility tools
stories.summary: accessiBe has updated its accessFlow platform into an agentic suite for websites and web apps. The tool integrates into design, code, and production environments to perform remediation work. Users approve every change made by the AI, allowing teams to decide where the automation makes the most business sense.

stories.title: Commerce launches AI shopping assistant
stories.summary: Commerce.com has introduced a customizable AI storefront assistant for BigCommerce merchants. The tool is designed to provide personalized product discovery and guide visitors through the buying process. The company claims the agent helps merchants turn shopper intent into conversions ahead of the holiday selling season.

stories.title: Bloomreach goes back to its roots with AthenaHQ acquisition - MarTech
Deloitte Digital releases agentic marketing tools
stories.summary: Deloitte Digital has introduced new agentic tools intended to address marketing workflow inefficiencies. The consultancy states that its marketing services arm is responding to internal data showing that the current pace of AI advancement is frequently hindered by existing organizational constraints.

stories.title: Brandlight releases enterprise tools for ChatGPT Business
stories.summary: Brandlight has launched a suite of tools designed to help enterprises prepare for the integration of ChatGPT Business. The company aims to assist organizations in managing the transition to AI-driven workflows within their existing enterprise infrastructure.

research.title: Dessins d'Enfants as a Topological Lens on Temporal Hypergraphs
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Hypergraphs are the natural language for group interactions, and topological data analysis has given us several ways to look at them: simplicial and cell complexes, persistent homology, and sheaves. All of these treat a hyperedge as. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Interpreting Timestamp Permutations in Dynamic Link Prediction
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Timestamp permutations are used to test whether dynamic link predictors exploit temporal information, but a performance gap can reflect changes in training, evaluation history, or both. We separate these effects with a crossed diagnostic and measure. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Ordinal Hegselmann-Krause Systems
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study opinion formation in the popular Hegselmann-Krause model when agents replace the traditional averaging update by a median update or more general ordinal aggregation methods. We analyze the convergence properties of synchronous and asynchronous dynamics. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
